task: Issue #125: use GitHub App installation tokens for projection writes

perspectives.summary: Replace the static client token with the existing per-installation provider, resolve the persisted board-owner installation for ProjectV2 writes, retain source installations for observer enrichment, and add forced refresh plus bounded retry semantics.

Fail closed on unknown/duplicate installation ownership, request and validate a minimum permission map, remove every static token/env/Secret path, and prove 401/429/GraphQL rate-limit handling without leaking credentials.

Use httptest fixtures for provider refresh, permission request, 401 rotation, rate limits, mixed-owner selection, and replay durability; require a sanitized DEV/App write verification before issue closure.

Keep the change bounded to token-aware client/server wiring, static credential contract removal, and documentation; do not redesign observer data or durable outbox semantics. Board-owner is the sole ProjectV2 writer.

consensus: Implement a board-owner installation-token projection path with no static fallback, explicit minimum permissions, bounded refresh/retry, and durable receipt replay tests. Treat real App permissions, DEV rollout, and protected write readback as external validation gates.
